problemCases.fig13-mixed-periods: Fig.13 is captioned Kushana but combines Q-14 (2014) and Q-15 (2023) frames, stone and mudbrick symbols, a ring well and a tile drain. Per-feature periods are not stated.
problemCases.fig13-stone-period-unassigned: Stone symbols on Fig.13 have no period of their own; the Kushan link is caption-level only.
problemCases.fig13-campus-position: Q-14/Q-15 campus position is unresolved; the plan is a local-coordinate inset, not a geolocated cut.
problemCases.fig13-B10-trench-tag: fig13-walls.json tags B10-Q15-northwest-wall-1 as Q-14/2014 while its annotation says “Q-15 extension”. Walls are hash-locked, so the record is unchanged; treat its trench as unresolved.
problemCases.two-drains: Two drains: the P1 Mauryan text drain (sealing floor of the Mauryan period) and the Fig.13 “TERRACOTTA TILES DRAIN” on the Kushan plan. Identity is unproven; model one only.
problemCases.two-ring-wells: Two ring wells: the P1 Mauryan text well (Fig.7, PIB photo) and the Fig.13 “RING WELL”. Identity is unproven; model one only.
problemCases.ring-well-arithmetic: 18 rings × mean 0.15 m = 2.70 m, but the reported depth is about 2.20 m.
problemCases.ring-well-cuts-older-layers: The Mauryan ring well cuts into Pre-Mauryan levels; it must not float inside a Mauryan slab.
problemCases.lane-spans-two-layers: The pottery-and-earth lane belongs to both Sunga and Kushan periods.
problemCases.dimension-axes-unlabelled: P1 gives “AxBxC” dimensions without naming axes; length × width × height is a reading, not stated.
problemCases.gupta-two-exposures: Two floor exposures, not necessarily two separate floors.
problemCases.mughal-finds-near-sultanate: Some Mughal pieces were collected near late Sultanate structures; finds are not tied to one level.
problemCases.silt-vs-n24-fluvial: P1 places silt below Pre-Mauryan levels; N24 reports PGW below a yellow fluvial deposit. These may be different exposures.
problemCases.temple-adjacency: Central temple-area evidence is not part of the slope composite.
problemCases.depth-gate: Use only if the model's deepest cut matches.
